raw:
"There was a grass fire near my campsite. I remember the smell of smoke inside my tent, and the flames climbing the dry bank. That’s the part that stays with me—the flames moving up that dry ground. It felt frighteningly close.

I’m an amateur stargazer, so a campsite makes me think of looking up at the sky. But what I remember about that time is much closer to the ground: the bank burning, and that smoke smell even inside the tent."
